name: smwgraphics-cosmic-cop-zone-a
title: Cosmic Cop - Zone A
description:
Background used in the first mission (Zone A) in Cosmic Cop (Arcade).

This is a HUGE background, it uses basically every tile besides FG3 and animations from FG1 and FG2 (for make it vanilla-collectables/FG compatible) and also 4 palette rows. It's still usable overall, but keep this in mind.
